svg.title: The Macro Transcension Hypothesis in five steps
svg.desc: An animated summary of Paper A. It moves from the hypothesis that some computation-optimizing civilizations migrate toward dense, rapidly spinning massive black holes, through the established physical advantages of energy extraction, entropy disposal, storage, and clock-rate control, to the predicted observable residues, the six falsification tests, and the unresolved current state of Omega Centauri. Current data preserve a kinematic lower bound of at least 8,200 solar masses and a pulsar-timing upper bound of about 6,000 solar masses. Electromagnetic silence is consistent with both the hypothesis and gas starvation. No detection is claimed.

g.text: A falsifiable selection theory built from black-hole physics. No detection of extraterrestrial technology is claimed.
